attchmntText: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Texmaco Rail and Engineering Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 11th November 2026. The company reported standalone revenue from operations of INR863 crores, a 15% increase from the previous quarter. EBITDA stood at INR88 crores with a margin of 10.2%, and profit was INR36 crores. The company delivered 1,106 wagons and produced 6,468 metric tons in its foundry. Export orders rose to 54% of the order book, up from 9% year-on-year. The total order book is approximately INR11,500 crores, with INR8,000 crores for freight rolling stock and INR3,000 to INR3,500 crores for infra and component businesses. CRISIL upgraded the company's long-term credit rating to A+ from A. The company confirmed no unpublished price sensitive information was shared during the call.

attchmntText: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited has received an order from IVC Logistics Limited for the supply and manufacturing of 464 wagons. The order value is Rs. 362.85 crores, including taxes. The wagons comprise Auto Car Taller wagon type ACT 3 and Brake Van type BVCM wagon. The entity awarding the order is domestic. The nature of the order is the supply and manufacturing of the specified wagons. The execution period is on a mutually agreed basis. The promoter group has no interest in the entity that awarded the order. The order does not fall within related party transactions. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015.

attchmntText: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Texmaco Rail and Engineering Limited received an order from North Western Railway valued at Rs. 48.60 crores, including taxes. The contract involves the supply of 968 sets of 1 in 12 BG Weldable CMS Crossing for 60E1 Rail in R-260 Grade on PSC Sleepers, in accordance with RDSO drawings. The order is domestic in nature. Execution will occur in a phased manner, with the final delivery date set for 11th January, 2029. The company confirms that no promoter, promoter group, or group companies have any interest in North Western Railway. Consequently, the order does not constitute a related party transaction.
